lines.japanese: コンビニに寄って、昼食用のパンも買ってきました。
lines.english: I stopped by a convenience store and bought some bread for lunch.

lines.japanese: さて、学校です。今日も一日お勤めしましょう。
lines.english: And now, school. Time to put in another honest day's work.

lines.japanese: 控えめに、控えめにね。
lines.english: Quietly. Quietly.

lines.japanese: タカシ君は控えめな学生生活を送っていたようなので、俺もそれに倣ってこの敷地内では控えめに。
lines.english: Takashi appeared to have led an unobtrusive school life, so I would follow his example and keep my head down on these grounds.

lines.japanese: 卒業までほんの二ヵ月強ですから。
lines.english: There were only a little over two months until graduation.

lines.japanese: いつもの道化根性ではしゃいだりはせず、水のように空気のように、無色透明な一生徒“羽田鷹志”として残りの期間をやり過ごしてしまいましょう。
lines.english: I would refrain from capering about in my usual clownish fashion and pass the remaining time like water, like air: one colorless, transparent student named Takashi Haneda.

lines.japanese: というわけで──
lines.english: And so—

lines.japanese: 「ぬるっと行かない！」
lines.english: “No keeping it slippery!”

lines.japanese: 「はよーっす……」
lines.english: “Morning...”

lines.japanese: 控えめに挨拶しながら教室へ入りました。
lines.english: I entered the classroom with an unobtrusive greeting.

lines.japanese: とくに御返事もいただかないまま着席。ええ、構いません。むしろお構いなく。
lines.english: I took my seat without receiving much of a reply. Yes, that was fine. Please, pay me no mind.

lines.japanese: そりゃあちょっと寂しい気はしますが、下手に交流を図って「おまえ性格変わったな」とか「おまえ本当に羽田か？」なんて不審に思われては困ります。
lines.english: It was a little lonely, but if I tried too hard to socialize, people might grow suspicious and say, “Your personality changed,” or “Are you really Haneda?”

lines.japanese: ま、すでにいるんですけどね、俺たちの事情を知っているクラスメイトも。三名ばかり。
lines.english: Well, there were already classmates who knew our circumstances. Three of them, in fact.

lines.japanese: ほら、噂をすればその筆頭がやってきますよ。
lines.english: Speak of the devil, and here came the foremost among them.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう羽田君──」
lines.english: “Good morning, Haneda—”

lines.japanese: 「──じゃないのか、ちぇ」
lines.english: “—or not. Damn.”

lines.japanese: 「露骨に挑発するなあ」
lines.english: “What a blatant provocation.”

lines.japanese: 乗りませんけどね。
lines.english: I wasn't taking the bait.

lines.japanese: 「てか、顔見ただけで分かるんすね」
lines.english: “You can tell just by looking at my face?”

lines.japanese: 中身、タカシ君じゃないって。
lines.english: That the person inside wasn't Takashi, I meant.

lines.japanese: 「そりゃね」
lines.english: “Of course.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君はそんなへらへら締まらない顔してないですから」
lines.english: “I'm afraid Haneda doesn't go around with that sloppy grin on his face.”

lines.japanese: うわあ、今日も手厳しいっすね明日香さん。
lines.english: As cutting as ever this morning, Asuka.

lines.japanese: 中途半端に敬語混じりなところがまた、アンタは同級生の羽田君じゃないザマスと主張しているようで心憎いっす。
lines.english: The way she mixed in a bit of polite speech made it sound as though she were declaring, *You are not Haneda, my classmate,* which was particularly galling.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、よくご存知で。さすがはタカシ君の彼女、恋の眼鏡は真実を見通しますか」
lines.english: “My, you know him well. As expected of Takashi's girlfriend. The eyes of love see all truths.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、恋とか愛とかじゃないっての。そういう茶化しキライ。おっさんっぽい」
lines.english: “I keep telling you, it wasn't love or romance. I hate that teasing. You sound like an old man.”

lines.japanese: 「だーって、チョイチョイ茶化し入れてかなかったら、うちら最終的には取っ組み合いのケンカしてそーじゃないっすか」
lines.english: “Buuut if I don't slip in a little teasing now and then, don't you think we'll end up in an all-out brawl?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、一理ありますね」
lines.english: “You have a point.”

lines.japanese: 「あんのかよ」
lines.english: “I do?”

lines.japanese: えー、というわけで。
lines.english: And so.

lines.japanese: 俺の元彼女（ということになっている）を紹介しましょう。
lines.english: Allow me to introduce my former girlfriend. (Officially speaking.)

lines.japanese: こちら、渡来さん家の明日香さん。
lines.english: This is Asuka Watarai of the Watarai household.

lines.japanese: ちょっと事情は特殊なんですが、彼女はタカシ君と表向きの恋人関係にあったひとです。
lines.english: The circumstances were a little unusual, but she had publicly been in a relationship with Takashi.

lines.japanese: あくまで表向きであって、そこに恋愛感情はなかった。と明日香さんは証言しています。純粋にひとりの人間として尊敬していただけだと。
lines.english: Only publicly; there were no romantic feelings involved. So Asuka testified. She merely respected him as a human being.

lines.japanese: なんにせよ今でもかなりの執着があることは、この千歳鷲介に対する反抗的というか敵対的というか、早よタカシ返せや的な態度で伺い知ることができます。
lines.english: Whatever the case, her continuing attachment was obvious from the defiant—or hostile—or perhaps *give Takashi back already*—attitude she took toward yours truly, Shuusuke Chitose.

lines.japanese: 「あのぉ、何度も伺って恐縮ですけどぉ、羽田君はいつ戻ってくるんですかぁ？」
lines.english: “I'm *so* sorry to ask yet again, but when will Haneda be back?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、何度も申しあげて恐縮ですけど、今後はワタクシが羽田タカシだとお考えください」
lines.english: “And I'm terribly sorry to repeat myself, but from now on, please consider *me* Takashi Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「おっさん千歳なんたらだろ」
lines.english: “You're that old guy, Chitose Whatever.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田タカシの人生を引きついだ千歳鷲介です」
lines.english: “I'm Shuusuke Chitose, heir to the life of Takashi Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「ヤなんですけど」
lines.english: “I don't want you.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、すみません。アナタがヤかヤじゃないかは私共の知ったこっちゃないですねえ」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sorry. Whether you want me is none of our concern.”

lines.japanese: 「うふふ、頭ブン殴って意識飛ばせば替わったりしないかしら？」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. Think if I punched you unconscious, you'd switch?”

lines.japanese: にこやかに交わされる笑顔とは裏腹に、空気がぴりぴりと張りつめています。
lines.english: Despite our cheerful smiles, the air between us crackled with tension.

lines.japanese: こんなところへ進んで飛びこんでくるのは、よほどの物好きか空気を読めないひとぐらいでしょう。
lines.english: Only someone with remarkably strange tastes or no ability to read the room would willingly leap into this.

lines.japanese: 「ほォ？　朝っぱらから痴話ゲンカとはロックじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Hoh? A lovers' quarrel first thing in the morning? That's rock and roll.”

lines.japanese: 「うそ、修羅場！？　やだ言ってよ、ソレ私の超得意分野！」
lines.english: “No way, a love triangle?! You should've told me! That's my specialty!”

lines.japanese: 物好きと空気読めないひとが同時にやってきました。
lines.english: The eccentric and the oblivious arrived simultaneously.

lines.japanese: 「すごいからね私、痴情もつれさせたら天才だからね！　まとまる話もたちどころにこんがらっちゃうし、嫉妬束縛あたりまえで泥沼展開まちがいないよ。どうする羽田君、こんど学校休んでうちで昼ドラ見る？」
lines.english: “I'm amazing, you know. A genius at tangling romance! Give me any simple relationship and I'll knot it up instantly. Jealousy, possessiveness, the whole sordid mess—guaranteed! Hey, Haneda, want to skip school and watch daytime soaps at my place?”

lines.japanese: 「はは、わけが分からないよ山科さん」
lines.english: “Haha. I have no idea what you're talking about, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: タカシ君っぽいリアクションをしてみたら、横で明日香さんが苦い顔になりました。
lines.english: I tried reacting like Takashi, and Asuka grimaced beside me.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君の物真似すんな」
lines.english: “Don't impersonate Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 物真似て。嫌な言い方をなさる。
lines.english: *Impersonate.* What an unpleasant way to put it.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね渡来さん。でもおれ、タカシ君のいたコミュニティでは、極力彼のように振るまいたいんだ。彼の築いてきた世界を引きつぐっていうのは、そういうことじゃないかと思うんだ」
lines.english: “Sorry, Watarai. But in communities where Takashi belonged, I want to behave as much like him as possible. I think that's what it means to inherit the world he built.”

lines.japanese: 俺は羽田タカシらしい真摯な表情で答えました。
lines.english: I answered with the earnest expression characteristic of Takashi Haneda.

lines.japanese: 「あァ、こいつ今日は羽田じゃねえのか」
lines.english: “Ah. So this guy isn't Haneda today.”

lines.japanese: 羽田タカシらしい真摯な表情で答えたのに即バレした！
lines.english: My earnest Takashi Haneda expression, and he saw through it instantly!

lines.japanese: 「なに言ってんの先輩、そんなの一目瞭然じゃん」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? Anyone can tell at a glance.”

lines.japanese: 「たしかに、羽田にしちゃァ、へらへら締まらねえ顔してンなァ」
lines.english: “True enough. That sloppy grin ain't Haneda's.”

lines.japanese: 「アレッ！？　いまはシリアスな顔してますよ！」
lines.english: “What?! I'm making a serious face right now!”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、ここんとこ毎ンち千歳だなァ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Been Chitose every damn day lately.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなの！？　やだ騙された、だって似てるんだもん！　似てるよね千歳＆羽田、興味ないからあんま見てないけど、たぶん目元のあたりが似てるよね。チョー似てるし、へらへら締まらない顔してるよね！」
lines.english: “Really?! Aw, you tricked me! They look alike! Chitose and Haneda look alike, right? I don't care enough to look closely, but maybe their eyes look alike. Super alike. Both wearing those sloppy, idiotic grins!”

lines.japanese: 「へらへら言いたいだけでしょおソレ！　文章つながってないでしょお！」
lines.english: “You just wanted to say ‘sloppy grin’! Those sentences don't even connect!”

lines.japanese: 「……っとと」
lines.english: “...Whoa.”

lines.japanese: いかんいかん、京さんのノリについ乗っかってしまった。羽田タカシらしからぬ激しいツッコミに、クラスの皆さんが奇異の視線を向けておいでです。
lines.english: Careful, careful. I had gotten swept up in Kyou's rhythm. My un-Takashi-like outburst drew curious looks from everyone in the class.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのすいません、俺の件に関してはいちおう機密事項としたいのでもう少しボリュームを……」
lines.english: “Um, excuse me. My situation is supposed to remain confidential, so could we keep our voices down...?”

lines.japanese: 「なあチェリーボーイズ。あのナリタとかイタミってのはもう出ねえの」
lines.english: “Hey, Cherry Boy. Those Narita and Itami guys ain't coming out anymore?”

lines.japanese: 「何それ。そんなもん出してる暇あったら羽田君出してよ」
lines.english: “Who cares about them? If you've got time to bring them out, bring Haneda back.”

lines.japanese: 「誰でもいいよ、誰でも出して大丈夫だよ。友達の友達はみな友達だからね。そのあたり山科京は分け隔てない博愛の精神を持ってるから、安心して誰でも出しなよ、すぽーんって。ほら、すぽーんすぽーんって！」
lines.english: “Anyone's fine. You can bring out whoever you like. A friend of my friend is my friend, so Kyou Yamashina embraces everyone equally. Don't worry, just pop anybody out. Pop, pop! Come on!”

lines.japanese: 「あの皆さん、声が大き……ていうか、そろそろこの話題は……」
lines.english: “Everyone, please, your voices are too... Actually, could we please change the subject...?”

lines.japanese: やっぱり教えなきゃ良かったかなァ……このひとたちには……。
lines.english: Maybe telling these people really had been a mistake...

lines.japanese: 明日香さんにはある日決定的な場面を目撃されてしまい、それをタネに脅迫めいた要求もあったので、やむを得ずあらかたの説明はしました。
lines.english: One day, Asuka had witnessed a decisive scene. She made a demand bordering on blackmail, so I had little choice but to explain most of it.

lines.japanese: というのは以前お話した通りですが。
lines.english: As I believe I mentioned before.

lines.japanese: その後、タカシ君の生活を引きつぐことに際して、俺はこのふたり──針生蔵人君と山科京さんにも、同様に事情を明かしたのです。
lines.english: Afterward, when I inherited Takashi’s life, I revealed the same circumstances to these two: Kuroudo Hariu and Kyou Yamashina.

lines.japanese: もっとも蔵人君はすでに成田隼人や伊丹伽楼羅とも面識がありましたし、カケル君から聞いてる部分もあったのでしょう、すでにほとんど知っているようなものでした。
lines.english: Granted, Kuroudo had already met Hayato Narita and Karura Itami, and Kakeru had probably told him part of it. He practically knew already.

lines.japanese: 京さんにも教えたのは──
lines.english: As for why I told Kyou—

lines.japanese: ──卒業文集制作にあたって、班員である彼女と接する機会の増えたことが大きな理由でしょう。
lines.english: —the main reason was probably that our work on the graduation anthology gave me more occasions to deal with her as a fellow committee member.

lines.japanese: だって、放課後の教室に四人だけ残って作業する日が続くんですよ。
lines.english: After all, the four of us kept staying behind in the classroom to work after school.

lines.japanese: 全員知らないという状況ならまだしも、逆に京さんだけが知らないわけですからね。不都合もあるし罪悪感も湧いてくるわけですよ。
lines.english: It might have been manageable if none of them knew, but Kyou alone had been left in the dark. That caused practical difficulties and made me feel guilty.

lines.japanese: そんなんで悶々としてたら、帰り道ふたりになったあるとき、彼女が言ったんです。
lines.english: While I agonized over it, we found ourselves alone on the walk home one day, and she said:

lines.japanese: 「ひとに言えないって辛いよね」
lines.english: “It's painful when you can't tell anyone.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「たとえば大事なひとを失くして、それがすごく辛くて、だからせめてその辛さを外へ発散することでほんの少しでも楽になりたいと思って──」
lines.english: “Say you lose someone important. It hurts terribly, so you want to ease that pain, even slightly, by letting it out—”

lines.japanese: 「──でも、それを誰かに話して疎まれたり煙たがられたりしたらやだなあって。そういうの、ない？」
lines.english: “—but then you worry that talking about it might annoy people or make them avoid you. Ever feel like that?”

lines.japanese: あるでしょ？　という表情で同意を求められました。
lines.english: Her expression asked me to agree, as though the answer were obvious.

lines.japanese: 突然のことに考えがまとまらず首をひねると、彼女はまぶたを伏せるように頷きました。
lines.english: The question came so suddenly that I tilted my head, unable to gather my thoughts. She nodded, lowering her eyelids.

lines.japanese: 「だから喪失感を内に留めておくことは、単純計算で二倍以上辛いと思うんだ」
lines.english: “So by simple arithmetic, keeping that sense of loss inside must hurt at least twice as much.”

lines.japanese: 「えっと……あの、山科さん？　ソレなんの話？」
lines.english: “Um... Yamashina? What are we talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ごめん。私の失恋話」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. I was talking about my own broken heart.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん……」
ほんとに？
lines.english: Really?

lines.japanese: 「ところで私、ひとに言えない病気を抱えてるんだけど──」
lines.english: “By the way, I have an illness I can't tell people about—”

lines.japanese: 「こ、今度は何の話？」
lines.english: “Wh-what are we talking about now?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　だから、私の病気話」
lines.english: “What? My illness, obviously.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、そうなんだろうけど……」
lines.english: “Well, yes, I suppose so...”

lines.japanese: なーんか言外のニュアンスを含んでそうな気がしたのです。
lines.english: I had the distinct feeling her words carried an unspoken implication.

lines.japanese: 「私、その病名を明かして、いい思いをした記憶がほとんどないんだ」
lines.english: “I can hardly remember a time when revealing its name did me any good.”

lines.japanese: ああ、なるほど。なんとなく彼女の真意が見えてきました。
lines.english: Ah, I understood. Her true intention was beginning to emerge.

lines.japanese: 「なんらかの人間関係を築いてく上で、ある程度信頼のようなものが芽生えたかなって段階が来るでしょ。そのとき、このひとなら大丈夫かな、分かってくれるかな、っと思って打ちあけると──」
lines.english: “When you're building some kind of relationship with another person, eventually you reach a stage where a certain degree of trust has grown, right? You think, maybe this person will be okay, maybe they'll understand, and you tell them—”

lines.japanese: 彼女は長い前髪を掻きわけて、その奥から出てきた瞳に人差し指を添えました。
lines.english: She brushed aside her long bangs and put an index finger beside the eye revealed beneath them.

lines.japanese: 「──目がね？　目の色っていうか、なんだろ、上手く言えないけど、とにかくそのひとの目が一瞬で変わっちゃうんだよね。こう、泳ぐっていうか、しれーっとした……なんて言ったらいい、アレ？」
lines.english: “—and their eyes? The color in them, or... I don't know how to say it. Anyway, their eyes change in an instant. They dart around, or go sort of blank... What do you call that?”

lines.japanese: まるで俺も経験者だと決めつけてるような問いかけでした。
lines.english: She asked as though she had already decided I had experienced it too.

lines.japanese: ま、経験者ですけどね。
lines.english: Which I had.

lines.japanese: 「ドン引き」
lines.english: “They're freaked out.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それだ。ひどいけど上手いこと言うね、君」
lines.english: “Oh, that’s it. Cruel, but nicely put.”

lines.japanese: 君とか言ってる。
lines.english: No “Haneda” this time.

lines.japanese: そういえば「羽田君」と呼ばれてたのは、俺に替わったごく最初のうちだけでした。
lines.english: Come to think of it, she had called me “Haneda” only at the very beginning after I took over.

lines.japanese: 洞察力に優れたひとなのかしら。
lines.english: Perhaps she was unusually perceptive.

lines.japanese: 「つまりなんですか、近からずも同種の悩みを持っている同士、腹を割って話せと？」
lines.english: “So what are you saying? That since we share not entirely dissimilar troubles, I should bare my heart to you?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなおこがましいことは言わないよ。ただ、私には受けいれる下地が出来てるから、君がちょっとでも話す気になったときは躊躇わないでいいって話」
lines.english: “I wouldn't presume to ask that. I'm only saying I have the groundwork to accept it, so if you ever feel even slightly inclined to talk, you needn't hesitate.”

lines.japanese: 「そーすか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: どこかのお姫さまと違って、最後まで踏みこんでこないその慎みが俺には心地よいものでした。
lines.english: Unlike a certain princess, she had the discretion not to barge all the way in. I found that comfortable.

lines.japanese: いいひとだなあ。もしタカシ君が消える前にこの子と親しくなっていたら、いまとは違う未来があったんじゃないでしょうか。
lines.english: She was a good person. If Takashi had grown close to her before he disappeared, perhaps a different future might have awaited him.

lines.japanese: 俺は千歳鷲介として微笑んで答えました。
lines.english: I smiled as Shuusuke Chitose and answered.

lines.japanese: 「お話は分かりました。前向きに検討させていただきますんで、ちょっと時間をください」
lines.english: “I understand what you're saying. I'll give it serious consideration, so please give me some time.”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ、ゆっくりで。興味本位に急いで聞きだそうなんてつもり全然ないから」
lines.english: “Sure, take all the time you need. I have absolutely no intention of prying it out of you just to satisfy my curiosity.”

lines.japanese: 「京さん……ありがとうございます……」
lines.english: “Kyou... Thank you...”

lines.japanese: 「ところで解離性同一性障害って知ってる？」
lines.english: “By the way, do you know what dissociative identity disorder is?”

lines.japanese: 「アレッ！？　聞きだす気まんまんですよ！」
lines.english: “What?! You're dying to pry it out of me!”

lines.japanese: で、次の日また帰りが一緒になったんで、カミングアウトしたわけですが。
lines.english: Then we happened to walk home together again the next day, so I came out to her.

lines.japanese: 「やだ千歳君、今日テンション高くない？　キマってんの？　なんか入れてるでしょ、分かる分かるパッキパキだよね！　元気なのはいいことだよ、その要因が外部刺激であれ化学物質であれ大差はないんだし！」
lines.english: “Wow, Chitose, aren't you wired today? Are you high? You're on something, I can tell—you're tweaking! Energy's a good thing, whether it comes from external stimuli or chemical substances. No real difference!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あの、もうちょっと声のボリュームを落として……あと俺、いま対外的には羽田だから……」
lines.english: “Um, could you lower your voice a little...? Also, in public I'm Haneda right now...”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！？　なに言ってんの千歳君、そんな弱気じゃ駄目だよ、バッドに落ちるよ。千歳も羽田も大差はないって言ってるじゃん！　ほらもっと元気よく、わっしょーい！　ケミカル千歳わっしょーい！」
lines.english: “What?! What are you saying, Chitose? You can't be that timid or you'll have a bad trip. I keep telling you, Chitose and Haneda aren't so different! Come on, put some spirit into it! Heave-ho! Chemical Chitose, heave-ho!”

lines.japanese: 「わ、わっしょーい！　わっしょーい！」
lines.english: “H-heave-ho! Heave-ho!”

lines.japanese: 制止すると反発してよけい騒がれるので、とりあえず彼女が飽きるまで同調することにしました。
lines.english: Trying to stop her only made her resist and shout louder, so I decided to play along until she grew bored.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、良かったな明日香。あいつ、羽田の真似はやめたみたいだぞ」
lines.english: “Hah! Good news, Asuka. Looks like he quit impersonating Haneda.”

lines.japanese: や、やめてない……。
lines.english: I-I had not...

lines.japanese: 「羽田君の真似すんなとは言ったけど、イメージ壊せとまでは言ってない」
lines.english: “I told you to stop impersonating Haneda, but I didn't tell you to destroy his reputation.”

lines.japanese: 壊してるつもりもありません……。
lines.english: I wasn't trying to...

lines.japanese: 「ＣＨＩ・ＴＯ・ＳＥ！　フゥ！　ＣＨＩ・ＴＯ・ＳＥ！　セィア！」
lines.english: “CHI-TO-SE! WOO! CHI-TO-SE! HAAH!”

lines.japanese: てか、いつ飽きんの京さん……。
lines.english: More importantly, when was Kyou going to get bored...?
